title: Silas Newton speech: beings interested in atomic research

tellings.quote: Unquestionably, they are interested in our atomic research.

plain: In 1950 a man named Silas Newton gave a speech in the United States about visitors from elsewhere, and his words are replayed in an episode of Jesse Michels' podcast. Newton says that these beings were, without question, interested in human atomic research. If true, it would mean non-human visitors were watching our work on nuclear power and weapons.
